instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Retail bank operating 45 branches across northern Portugal serving 180,000 individual and 12,000 business customers. Core product portfolio includes mortgages, consumer loans, current accounts, and SME lending. Currently executing a digital transformation roadmap including mobile-first account opening and AI-assisted credit adjudication.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm. We run quarterly hackathons, maintain a formal patent portfolio, and have a rotating 'innovation fellow' program where high-potential employees spend 6 months dedicated to exploratory projects. Last quarter we successfully integrated a proprietary natural language processing engine to automate initial loan application document review, significantly speeding up the underwriting process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.teamSize: Our digital and innovation organization includes 80+ professionals across centers of excellence for AI/ML, cloud engineering, UX design, and agile delivery. We run an internal incubator program that has graduated 6 new digital products to market in the past 2 years, alongside a corporate venture capital arm that makes strategic minority investments in relevant startups.
answers.additionalContext: Upcoming changes to industry-specific safety and certification standards will require us to recertify our entire product line over the next 2 years. The recertification process is expensive and time-consuming. We need innovation ideas that either accelerate the recertification workflow itself or deliver sufficient business value to justify the combined certification-plus-innovation investment.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized Wealth Management Tools
opportunities.rationale: Leverage existing AI/ML capabilities to move beyond basic credit scoring into predictive financial advisory services tailored for different demographic segments.

first_actions: Establish a pilot team focused on three high-net-worth customer personas
Define clear data requirements and necessary regulatory checks (KYC/AML)
Allocate 30% of the annual innovation budget to proof-of-concept development
resources_needed: UX design consultancy for advisory interface
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 5% adoption rate among pilot group within Q3
milestones: MVP launch of personalized advice module (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Embedded B2B Financial Compliance-as-a-Service
opportunities.rationale: Diversify revenue by offering specialized, subscription-based FinTech services that help SMEs manage complex regulatory reporting and compliance automatically.

first_actions: Form a strategic partnership with two specialized B2B SaaS providers
Identify the most common pain points in SME financial reporting/compliance workflows
Allocate seed funding for a dedicated startup venture or acquisition target research
resources_needed: Legal and compliance experts for cross-sector regulation mapping
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 1 strategic partnership agreement within the next 6 months
milestones: Formal business plan for venture/acquisition submission (Month 8)

opportunities.title: Automated Regulatory Workflow Acceleration Platform
opportunities.rationale: Focus on solving the immediate pain point of complex recertification by using internal AI to map existing operational data against new regulatory requirements.

first_actions: Map current product line certification steps vs. projected standards
Develop a lightweight workflow tool prototype leveraging RPA and NLP
Integrate the prototype with the central digital transformation office pipeline
resources_needed: Training budget for legacy system integration
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average certification preparation time by 25% within the next fiscal year
milestones: Workflow mapping and tool scoping complete (Month 3)
Alpha testing with one product line completed (Month 9)

next_steps.action: Establish a cross-functional task force prioritizing the B2B FinTech diversification track.
Conduct detailed feasibility study for the 'Financial Compliance-as-a-Service' radical opportunity and secure initial VC interest.
Implement a phased pilot of the hyper-personalized wealth management tool to test cultural readiness and ROI validation.

key_weaknesses: Siloed departmental adoption hindering cross-unit innovation scaling.
Formal process rigidity impeding rapid iteration required by the short time horizon.
Limited internal expertise in deep adjacent markets outside core retail banking products.
